description: Everything that happened near a Texas site or in a county over the last N days, newest first, by the date it happened: battery storage milestones (entered screening, study requested or approved, interconnection agreement signed, construction started, approved to energize), generation projects entering the ERCOT queue, TCEQ air permits filed or issued (including data centers), newly tracked planned grid projects, and Grid Report articles about the county. Counts by category come first. Use for 'what's new around this site', 'any new filings in Jackson County this month', or a periodic check on a watched area. Pro; free accounts see the counts.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

days.description: Look-back window in days. Default 30, max 365.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 25, max 150.

name: whats_new
title: What changed near a site or in a county
